critique.evidence: The dark grid, restrained cyan/red palette, outlined cards, monospace labels, and bold headline establish a cohesive security-lab aesthetic with clear conceptual contrast between normal and machine-visible layers. However, responsive composition is not presentation-ready: on desktop the full-width navigation bar cuts directly across the oversized headline; on tablet it overlaps the introductory copy and RESULTS ARTIFACT badge. The mobile header avoids that collision, but the red artifact section becomes cramped, with excessive wrapping, crowded badges, faint underlying mock content competing with foreground text, and awkwardly compressed outcome/control-point blocks. Small uppercase labels and muted blue-gray body copy are also difficult to read against the dark background.
critique.fix: Move the navigation into reserved header space so it never overlays page content, and retune headline size/top spacing at desktop and tablet breakpoints. On mobile, simplify the red preview: remove or further suppress the background mockup, increase inner padding and text contrast, stack comparison fields cleanly, and allow badges to wrap with consistent gaps. Raise the minimum size/line-height of micro-labels and muted explanatory text.
